original_question: Akwai dodon kodi guda 4 a cikin akwatin kifaye daya da wasu dodon kodin 32 a wani akwatin kifayen. Bambanci tsakanin adadin dodon kodi a cikin akwatunan guda biyu shine adadin kifaye sau biyu na cikin duka akwatunan. Idan duka akatunan suna da adadin kifaye iri ɗaya a cikinsu, kifaye nawa ne a kowace akwatin kifayen?
question_template: Akwai dodon kodi guda {num_digit_1, 4} a cikin akwatin kifaye daya da wasu dodon kodin {num_digit_2, 32} a wani akwatin kifayen. question_solution: answer = (num_digit_2 - num_digit_1) / (2 * f2)   # f2 is the numeric value of num_text_2
